name: McGill University
header:
McGill University
Canada · Mathematics and Statistics MA/MSc (thesis) / PhD
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 55. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• McCall MacBain2027deadline has already passed; UChicago’s location assigned the September 23deadline
even for a non-US citizen.
• The published master’s funding figure does not cover the listed international tuition/fees; resolve the actual
offer before comparing stipends.
• Non-thesis MA/MSc Math programs are not accepting applications.
• A US F-1 status does not establish Canadian citizenship, permanent residence or Canadian study-permit
status.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
A completed UChicago bachelor’s can satisfy the honours-equivalent mathematics preparation for a thesis
MA/MSc; central minimum GPA is 3.0/4 and department expects high standing plus abstract/linear algebra and
real/complex analysis. Math’s page requires a master’s for PhD, while central PhD 1 permits exceptional
bachelor’s applicants with GPA≥3.7 and substantial relevant research, including a research-supervisor letter.
Obtain explicit Mathematics approval before relying on PhD 1; otherwise apply master’s. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select thesis program and research group/area, arrange two instructor references, gather all university records
and prepare personal statement. Request the UChicago English exemption directly from the graduate
coordinator with documentary evidence. Resolve any proposed direct-PhD route before paying. Non-thesis
Math MA/MSc applications are not currently accepted. [s1] [s5] [s6] [s7]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
Math asks for research-group/area preferences, but its admission page does not expressly require a prior
supervisor agreement. Contact relevant faculty to check fit/2027 availability, and ask coordinator whether a
particular PhD route requires commitment. Pym’s webpage discusses Fall 2026 openings only, not 2027. [s1]
[s20]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use future.mcgill.ca. Reference requests can precede payment; submit/pay initial application, wait 10-15
minutes, then upload checklist documents and track progress. Official scores are sent by testing agency. [s3]
[s22]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Standing January 15 admission deadline corroborated by department and central program page; neither
explicitly dates it 2027. Scholarship 2027 dates explicit andalreadyclosed. Math funding table remains
2025-26; central application fee labels Summer 2027. [s1] [s2] [s8] [s9] [s10]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing Fall schedule: opens 15 September; deadline 15 January for international and domestic applicants.
Pages do not explicitly label that date 2027 or publish clock/time zone; portal is designated most current.
Winter international deadline is 15 July. [s1] [s2]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Ordinary departmental full admission/funding consideration: 15 January standing Fall deadline. McCall MacBain
Summer/Fall 2027 is CLOSED: UChicago students/graduates had 23 September 2026, 4 pm Eastern (based on
US university attendance, not citizenship); other-country university applicants had 19 August. Finalists must
apply to McGill in December even if program deadline is later. [s1] [s10]
Reference receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All supporting materials are due by the program application deadline unless explicitly excepted; no published
Math grace period. Thus plan for the standing 15 January Fall deadline. McCall MacBain had a separate 23
September 2026, 4 pm Eastern deadline including references for UChicago applicants. [s1] [s3] [s12]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Any required scores must arrive by application deadline. Tests are sent by agency; allow at least ten business
days for matching. If approaching deadline, graduate coordinator may be shown proof of transmission. No
GRE-specific late grace period stated. English degree exemption should be confirmed instead of assuming
portal completion. [s3] [s22]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal mathematics acceptance date verified in public department and graduate admissions pages.
Follow the individual offer; do not assume April 15. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
If no exemption: TOEFL new scale overall 4.5, R/L/W 4.5 and S 4.0; old scale 86 with each 20; IELTS Academic
6.5. Official electronic agency reports, valid 2 years. TOEFL MyBest, IELTS Online/One Skill Retake, Duolingo
and PTE are not accepted. [s5] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Yes under standing rule: an earned OR about-to-be-earned recognized US undergraduate degree normally
removes testing. Send proof directly to the department so it can waive the checklist item. This applies
independently of citizenship/F-1; exemption is not necessarily automatic. [s5]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not a Math admissions requirement. Unlike Math Subject GRE, no recommendation for pure mathematics
General GRE was found. Central guidance says do not send tests unless departmental site or portal lists them
as required/optional; check before ordering General GRE. [s1] [s3]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Encouraged, if available, for pure/applied mathematics applicants without a prior Canadian preparatory
degree. This includes a UChicago-only applicant. Not required; agency code 0935. [s1]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two instructors familiar with the applicant’s work. If asking for exceptional PhD 1 consideration, central policy
additionally requires evidence from a research supervisor; confirm whether one of the two must fulfil this role
or an extra letter is wanted. [s1] [s6]
Scholarship references [2027 confirmed]
McCall MacBain required two distinct online forms: academic and community. Faithful paraphrase of each:
relationship 30 words; trait ratings 1-5; academic suitability/comparison or community contribution 160 words;
strongest-quality example 130 words; growth-area assessment 130 words. Academic traits concern curiosity,
integrity, originality, effort, openness, achievement and learning; community adds listening, resilience,
empathy, teamwork, service and leadership. This is not satisfied by ordinary admission letters. [s12]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Entering a referee in the McGill application triggers an automated secure invitation. The referee can submit
before application payment. Use institutional email; exceptions require coordinator validation. Scholarship
requests use a separate explicit Send to Recommender action. [s3] [s4] [s11]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
No: admission references may be uploaded before applicant submission/payment. Other supporting documents
become uploadable after submission and payment processing. [s3] [s22]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Admission letter receipt generates an applicant email and updates the checklist. Applicants can send
reminders; decline notifications permit replacement. Scholarship form receipt also produces an email
confirmation. [s4] [s11]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Admission letters must identify the program, be dated within 12 months and give writer position/contact
information. Referee contact details/replacements can be managed in portal. A submitted letter’s update/reuse
across programs is not guaranteed publicly; ask coordinator. Files already in review cannot be changed without
unit authorization. [s4] [s3]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
Separate admission CV not listed in Math’s required documents; no public length/format established. McCall
MacBain separately required one-page PDF résumé, font≥10 pt, no photo, opening 1-2 sentence summary. [s1]
[s7] [s11]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required document is called Personal Statement. Faithful paraphrase: explain preferred research groups/areas
and relevant context absent from transcripts. Upload through McGill portal; length, font and spacing not stated
publicly. No separate SOP identified. [s1]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Same required Personal Statement described above; no separate background/diversity essay in department
checklist. Limit and formatting require confirmation. [s1] [s7]

Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required within Personal Statement, addressing preferred research group(s) and area(s); no separately
specified research-interest document. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
Optional thesis-research proposal, maximum one page. Most students decide a specific project after first year.
Upload document, not merely a link; font/spacing not published. [s1]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Unresolved]
No full thesis, paper or writing sample listed in Math admissions checklist; no verified optional upload/link
provision. [s1] [s7]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No separate publications list requested publicly. Relevant achievements may be described in personal
statement; no required attached papers established. [s1] [s7]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
Not separately requested in the published Mathematics checklist; transcript documents preparation. No public
independent course-list/description prompt or limit; do not invent an extra upload. Confirm live checklist. [s1]
[s7]
Scholarship essays [2027 confirmed]
McCall MacBain 2027 closed. Faithful paraphrases/limits: three short answers (105 characters each): former
pursuit; two nonacademic goals; three new personal facts. Essays: community influence 225 words;
program/goals 225; leadership role 50, selection 25, goals/results 100, setback 50, lessons 50; service
contribution 250; life pivot 250. List up to 3 leadership and 3 service roles,4 community activities,3
creative/academic works,5 break activities and 5 jobs. Upload transcripts; optional transcript context 50 words.
Exact prompts at source; no additional essay typography specified. [s11]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Scholarship required university endorsement for current international students and activity verifiers; applicant
must certify own unedited writing. Admission’s public checklist does not establish additional short answers;
inspect paid portal checklist. [s11] [s4]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Published 2025-26 figures, not 2027 offer: international thesis master’s CAD 14,150 first 12 months +CAD
4,720 months 13-16; international PhD CAD 33,250/year. TA is additional and not guaranteed (published CAD
36.25/hour, up to 150 hours/term). Table also charges international master’s annual tuitionCAD
20,726.70+feesCAD 3,172.10, and PhD tuitionCAD 18,604.80+feesCAD 3,172.10. Request a net-cost
calculation: listed master’s guarantee alone is below tuition/fees. [s8]
Years of support [Prior cycle]
Published guarantee: thesis master’s 16 months; PhD 4 years. PhD 5-status tuition/funding can both fall to
domestic levels without changing net take-home. Direct-entry PhD 1 fifth-year coverage not resolved. [s8]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department says all accepted master’s/doctoral students receive funding; published table explicitly includes
international students. McCall MacBain includes international candidates but 2027 applications are closed. [s7]
[s8] [s10]
Conditions and duties [Prior cycle]
Published funding is not a tuition waiver and excludes TA; students need not accept a TA offer. Exact progress
conditions, summer distribution and external-award interactions are offer-specific and not established by this
brief table. [s8]

Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Ordinary departmental funding is considered with admission by the departmental deadline. McCall MacBain
required a separate earlier application, two special references and university endorsement; it is not an
automatic admission award. [s1] [s10] [s11] [s12]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
McCall MacBain covers normal-duration tuition/fees plus CAD 2,300/month during academic terms and
relocation grant; nonacademic summers may receive up toCAD 5,000 by application. This is a competitive
separate master’s scholarship, not a 12 month automatic stipend, and 2027 entry isclosed. Department also
offers scholarship/stipend and TA opportunities; eligibility of other external awards must be checked
individually. [s13] [s7]
Application fee [Conflict]
Current central fee schedule/FAQ specifically quotes CAD 143.82 for Summer 2027, covering up to two
programs in one term. Fall 2027 management pages use that figure, but Math-specific Fall 2027 charge not
independently published: verify portal before payment. Credit card Visa/Mastercard/AmEx; nonrefundable. [s3]
[s9]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies explicitly offers no application-fee waivers. If the second same-term
program incorrectly requests another fee, ask the graduate coordinator to waive that duplicate charge; this is
not a need-based fee waiver. [s3]

text:
McGill University
Canada · Mathematics and Statistics MA/MSc (thesis) / PhD
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 55. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• McCall MacBain2027deadline has already passed; UChicago’s location assigned the September 23deadline
even for a non-US citizen.
• The published master’s funding figure does not cover the listed international tuition/fees; resolve the actual
offer before comparing stipends.
• Non-thesis MA/MSc Math programs are not accepting applications.
• A US F-1 status does not establish Canadian citizenship, permanent residence or Canadian study-permit
status.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
A completed UChicago bachelor’s can satisfy the honours-equivalent mathematics preparation for a thesis
MA/MSc; central minimum GPA is 3.0/4 and department expects high standing plus abstract/linear algebra and
real/complex analysis. Math’s page requires a master’s for PhD, while central PhD 1 permits exceptional
bachelor’s applicants with GPA≥3.7 and substantial relevant research, including a research-supervisor letter.
Obtain explicit Mathematics approval before relying on PhD 1; otherwise apply master’s. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select thesis program and research group/area, arrange two instructor references, gather all university records
and prepare personal statement. Request the UChicago English exemption directly from the graduate
coordinator with documentary evidence. Resolve any proposed direct-PhD route before paying. Non-thesis
Math MA/MSc applications are not currently accepted. [s1] [s5] [s6] [s7]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
Math asks for research-group/area preferences, but its admission page does not expressly require a prior
supervisor agreement. Contact relevant faculty to check fit/2027 availability, and ask coordinator whether a
particular PhD route requires commitment. Pym’s webpage discusses Fall 2026 openings only, not 2027. [s1]
[s20]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use future.mcgill.ca. Reference requests can precede payment; submit/pay initial application, wait 10-15
minutes, then upload checklist documents and track progress. Official scores are sent by testing agency. [s3]
[s22]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Standing January 15 admission deadline corroborated by department and central program page; neither
explicitly dates it 2027. Scholarship 2027 dates explicit andalreadyclosed. Math funding table remains
2025-26; central application fee labels Summer 2027. [s1] [s2] [s8] [s9] [s10]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing Fall schedule: opens 15 September; deadline 15 January for international and domestic applicants.
Pages do not explicitly label that date 2027 or publish clock/time zone; portal is designated most current.
Winter international deadline is 15 July. [s1] [s2]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Ordinary departmental full admission/funding consideration: 15 January standing Fall deadline. McCall MacBain
Summer/Fall 2027 is CLOSED: UChicago students/graduates had 23 September 2026, 4 pm Eastern (based on
US university attendance, not citizenship); other-country university applicants had 19 August. Finalists must
apply to McGill in December even if program deadline is later. [s1] [s10]
Reference receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
All supporting materials are due by the program application deadline unless explicitly excepted; no published
Math grace period. Thus plan for the standing 15 January Fall deadline. McCall MacBain had a separate 23
September 2026, 4 pm Eastern deadline including references for UChicago applicants. [s1] [s3] [s12]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Any required scores must arrive by application deadline. Tests are sent by agency; allow at least ten business
days for matching. If approaching deadline, graduate coordinator may be shown proof of transmission. No
GRE-specific late grace period stated. English degree exemption should be confirmed instead of assuming
portal completion. [s3] [s22]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal mathematics acceptance date verified in public department and graduate admissions pages.
Follow the individual offer; do not assume April 15. [s1] [s3]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
If no exemption: TOEFL new scale overall 4.5, R/L/W 4.5 and S 4.0; old scale 86 with each 20; IELTS Academic
6.5. Official electronic agency reports, valid 2 years. TOEFL MyBest, IELTS Online/One Skill Retake, Duolingo
and PTE are not accepted. [s5] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Yes under standing rule: an earned OR about-to-be-earned recognized US undergraduate degree normally
removes testing. Send proof directly to the department so it can waive the checklist item. This applies
independently of citizenship/F-1; exemption is not necessarily automatic. [s5]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not a Math admissions requirement. Unlike Math Subject GRE, no recommendation for pure mathematics
General GRE was found. Central guidance says do not send tests unless departmental site or portal lists them
as required/optional; check before ordering General GRE. [s1] [s3]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Encouraged, if available, for pure/applied mathematics applicants without a prior Canadian preparatory
degree. This includes a UChicago-only applicant. Not required; agency code 0935. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload complete unofficial records to date from every university attended. Include diploma if conferral is
absent from transcript. Non-English/French records require certified or institution-issued translation plus
original. Official copies are requested after an admission offer. [s4]

Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Unresolved]
Not separately requested in the published Mathematics checklist; transcript documents preparation. No public
independent course-list/description prompt or limit; do not invent an extra upload. Confirm live checklist. [s1]
[s7]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two instructors familiar with the applicant’s work. If asking for exceptional PhD 1 consideration, central policy
additionally requires evidence from a research supervisor; confirm whether one of the two must fulfil this role
or an extra letter is wanted. [s1] [s6]
Scholarship references [2027 confirmed]
McCall MacBain required two distinct online forms: academic and community. Faithful paraphrase of each:
relationship 30 words; trait ratings 1-5; academic suitability/comparison or community contribution 160 words;
strongest-quality example 130 words; growth-area assessment 130 words. Academic traits concern curiosity,
integrity, originality, effort, openness, achievement and learning; community adds listening, resilience,
empathy, teamwork, service and leadership. This is not satisfied by ordinary admission letters. [s12]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Entering a referee in the McGill application triggers an automated secure invitation. The referee can submit
before application payment. Use institutional email; exceptions require coordinator validation. Scholarship
requests use a separate explicit Send to Recommender action. [s3] [s4] [s11]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
No: admission references may be uploaded before applicant submission/payment. Other supporting documents
become uploadable after submission and payment processing. [s3] [s22]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Admission letter receipt generates an applicant email and updates the checklist. Applicants can send
reminders; decline notifications permit replacement. Scholarship form receipt also produces an email
confirmation. [s4] [s11]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Admission letters must identify the program, be dated within 12 months and give writer position/contact
information. Referee contact details/replacements can be managed in portal. A submitted letter’s update/reuse
across programs is not guaranteed publicly; ask coordinator. Files already in review cannot be changed without
unit authorization. [s4] [s3]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
Separate admission CV not listed in Math’s required documents; no public length/format established. McCall
MacBain separately required one-page PDF résumé, font≥10 pt, no photo, opening 1-2 sentence summary. [s1]
[s7] [s11]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required document is called Personal Statement. Faithful paraphrase: explain preferred research groups/areas
and relevant context absent from transcripts. Upload through McGill portal; length, font and spacing not stated
publicly. No separate SOP identified. [s1]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Same required Personal Statement described above; no separate background/diversity essay in department
checklist. Limit and formatting require confirmation. [s1] [s7]

Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required within Personal Statement, addressing preferred research group(s) and area(s); no separately
specified research-interest document. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
Optional thesis-research proposal, maximum one page. Most students decide a specific project after first year.
Upload document, not merely a link; font/spacing not published. [s1]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Unresolved]
No full thesis, paper or writing sample listed in Math admissions checklist; no verified optional upload/link
provision. [s1] [s7]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No separate publications list requested publicly. Relevant achievements may be described in personal
statement; no required attached papers established. [s1] [s7]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
Not separately requested in the published Mathematics checklist; transcript documents preparation. No public
independent course-list/description prompt or limit; do not invent an extra upload. Confirm live checklist. [s1]
[s7]
Scholarship essays [2027 confirmed]
McCall MacBain 2027 closed. Faithful paraphrases/limits: three short answers (105 characters each): former
pursuit; two nonacademic goals; three new personal facts. Essays: community influence 225 words;
program/goals 225; leadership role 50, selection 25, goals/results 100, setback 50, lessons 50; service
contribution 250; life pivot 250. List up to 3 leadership and 3 service roles,4 community activities,3
creative/academic works,5 break activities and 5 jobs. Upload transcripts; optional transcript context 50 words.
Exact prompts at source; no additional essay typography specified. [s11]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Scholarship required university endorsement for current international students and activity verifiers; applicant
must certify own unedited writing. Admission’s public checklist does not establish additional short answers;
inspect paid portal checklist. [s11] [s4]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Published 2025-26 figures, not 2027 offer: international thesis master’s CAD 14,150 first 12 months +CAD
4,720 months 13-16; international PhD CAD 33,250/year. TA is additional and not guaranteed (published CAD
36.25/hour, up to 150 hours/term). Table also charges international master’s annual tuitionCAD
20,726.70+feesCAD 3,172.10, and PhD tuitionCAD 18,604.80+feesCAD 3,172.10. Request a net-cost
calculation: listed master’s guarantee alone is below tuition/fees. [s8]
Years of support [Prior cycle]
Published guarantee: thesis master’s 16 months; PhD 4 years. PhD 5-status tuition/funding can both fall to
domestic levels without changing net take-home. Direct-entry PhD 1 fifth-year coverage not resolved. [s8]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department says all accepted master’s/doctoral students receive funding; published table explicitly includes
international students. McCall MacBain includes international candidates but 2027 applications are closed. [s7]
[s8] [s10]
Conditions and duties [Prior cycle]
Published funding is not a tuition waiver and excludes TA; students need not accept a TA offer. Exact progress
conditions, summer distribution and external-award interactions are offer-specific and not established by this
brief table. [s8]

Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Ordinary departmental funding is considered with admission by the departmental deadline. McCall MacBain
required a separate earlier application, two special references and university endorsement; it is not an
automatic admission award. [s1] [s10] [s11] [s12]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
McCall MacBain covers normal-duration tuition/fees plus CAD 2,300/month during academic terms and
relocation grant; nonacademic summers may receive up toCAD 5,000 by application. This is a competitive
separate master’s scholarship, not a 12 month automatic stipend, and 2027 entry isclosed. Department also
offers scholarship/stipend and TA opportunities; eligibility of other external awards must be checked
individually. [s13] [s7]
Application fee [Conflict]
Current central fee schedule/FAQ specifically quotes CAD 143.82 for Summer 2027, covering up to two
programs in one term. Fall 2027 management pages use that figure, but Math-specific Fall 2027 charge not
independently published: verify portal before payment. Credit card Visa/Mastercard/AmEx; nonrefundable. [s3]
[s9]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies explicitly offers no application-fee waivers. If the second same-term
program incorrectly requests another fee, ask the graduate coordinator to waive that duplicate charge; this is
not a need-based fee waiver. [s3]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Department PhD page requires master’s whereas central policy allows exceptional bachelor’s PhD 1: do not
silently generalize exception to Math. Degree-in-progress English exemption clarified centrally. Current fee
wording is Summer 2027, so Fall exact amountneedsportalconfirmation. [s1] [s5] [s6] [s9]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm Math PhD 1 availability, Fall 2027 deadline time zone/clock, personal-statement length/format, current
funding net of international tuition and direct-entry duration, exact application fee, commitment date and
submitted-letter update/reuse. Faculty shortlist covers primary algebraic/arithmetic/complex and
representation matches; analytic geometry/PDE specialists are not exhaustively listed. [s1] [s3] [s8] [s14]
